exercise.title: Hammer and pull, both finger pairs
exercise.why: Trilling fingers 1 and 3, then 2 and 4, at the same tempo puts the two pairs side by side, so you hear which one hammers weaker and needs the practice.

cells.text:
Press Play on the first tab below to start the metronome. Pick the first note once, then trill fingers 1 and 3 with hammer-ons and pull-offs, one note per beat.
When both notes are even, try a faster stage. Use the Stage selector below to change the tempo, then press Play to start the metronome again.

Then press Play on the second tab and do the same with fingers 2 and 4.
When you change pairs, listen for the one whose hammered note is quieter: that is the pair to practise more.
